# GOOG — Catalysts

## TL;DR

Q1 2026 earnings (April 29 post-market) fully priced in the April 30 +10% gap-up: EPS $5.11 vs. $2.62 consensus, revenue $109.9B, Google Cloud $20B quarterly (+63% YoY), net income +81% YoY. Next identifiable catalyst: Google I/O 2026 (May 19–20), now approximately 10 trading days away — within the 10-day pre-positioning window in principle, but swing_catalyst_news (run 20260505_164543) still refuses entry due to 3-sigma chart extension and unfavorable R/R. Persistent overhangs: DOJ cross-appeal, $190B capex (raised from $180–190B midpoint), and Iran geopolitical escalation (WTI ~$104/bbl). (Source: web_research/GOOG.json, run 20260505_164543)

## Upcoming events

| Date | Event | Sentiment |

| May 19–20, 2026 | Google I/O 2026 — AI Mode, agentic commerce, Gemini updates, new hardware; Gemini in Workspace already rolling out | Positive catalyst |
| June 2026 | Next FOMC meeting | Macro; indirect |
| July 22–23, 2026 (est.) | Q2 2026 earnings (consensus EPS ~$2.86) | Binary; high impact |

Source: web_research/GOOG.json, run 20260505_164543.

## Recent news synthesis

**Q1 2026 earnings (massively positive — fully priced).** EPS $5.11 vs. $2.62 estimate (+94%); net income $62.58B (+81% YoY); revenue $109.9B (+20% YoY); Google Cloud +63% YoY crossing $20B quarterly for the first time; cloud backlog nearly doubled QoQ to $460B+. The April 30 +10% gap on 2.6x average volume has fully absorbed the beat. Alphabet raised 2026 capex guidance to as much as $190B, signaling aggressive AI infrastructure commitment. (Source: web_research/GOOG.json, run 20260505_164543)

**Google I/O 2026 — May 19–20 (~10 trading days out).** AI-heavy keynotes expected (AI Mode, agentic commerce, Gemini updates, new hardware). Gemini in Workspace began rolling out May 4. Per swing_catalyst_news: entering a 3-sigma-extended chart for a pre-IO trade creates unfavorable R/R — revisit 3–5 trading days before the event when price extension may have normalized. (Source: web_research/GOOG.json, swing_catalyst_news, run 20260505_164543)

**Google Cloud and AI momentum (structural positive).** Pentagon AI deal signed (classified work). Google Ironwood custom AI chip launched — potential Nvidia competitor in AI accelerators. Gemini grew to ~13% AI assistant share. Cloud backlog $460B+ with Q2 data center spend accelerating. Revenue from generative AI products grew ~800% YoY in Q1 2026. (Source: web_research/GOOG.json, run 20260505_164543)

**Antitrust — DOJ cross-appeal still live (negative tail risk).** Morgan Stanley estimates search index sharing puts $15–25B in annual ad revenue at risk if rivals build on the Google index. Unresolved. (Source: prior web_research; run 20260501_164617)

**Capex overhang — ongoing.** Full-year 2026 capex guidance raised to as much as $190B, with 2027 signaled to "significantly increase." FCF compression persists near-term. (Source: web_research/GOOG.json, run 20260505_164543)

**Iran macro escalation — risk-off headwind.** WTI ~$104/bbl, Brent ~$112.90. Strait of Hormuz closure remains a tail risk. Nasdaq partially recovered May 5 (ATH intraday) but Iran conflict unresolved. High-valuation growth stocks disproportionately exposed. (Source: web_research/GOOG.json macro_context, run 20260505_164543)

No fresh insider trades in current facts bundle. Prior context: net insider flow −$682M characterized as routine RSU vesting — not discretionary selling. No discretionary buying signal confirmed. (Source: growth_analyst_agent, swing_catalyst_news, run 20260505_164543)

## Format

Each lesson is one dated bullet:

`[DATE] | [TICKER] | [SETUP TYPE] | [OUTCOME: +$X / -$X] | [WHY it worked or failed in 1 sentence]`

The "why" should reference: the thesis at the time, the macro regime, which swing strategy recommended it.

## Lessons

2026-04-30 | NVDA | EMA pullback Fib dip-buy | -$63.20 (corrected from -$264.65) | Stop triggered at $205.30 (hourly Fib 61.8%); swing_trend_momentum and swing_breakout were bullish on AI capex thesis, but price breached the stop zone intraday amid stretched macro (RSI 81–87) with no bullish confirmation candle before exit. **Note:** trade was originally sized 67 shares ($14,020) due to a phantom $100K budget bug (fixed commit b2b472d). With the correct $25K budget at 14.2% vol-adj limit, position would have been 16 shares ($3,348). Corrected P&L reflects the strategy's actual signal quality, not the sizing error.
2026-05-04 | AMZN | mean-reversion fade short | OUTCOME: -$10.14 | Mean-reversion short thesis (April 30 shooting star, RSI 82–88) stopped at $276 as extreme ADX 65 trend absorbed the reversal; swing_mean_reversion recommended the setup but the regime (ADX 60+) sets an elevated bar for fading overbought conditions confirmed by identical NVDA stop-out April 30.
2026-05-05 | DIS | pre-earnings breakout long | OUTCOME: -$4.99 | Pre-earnings breakout above $103 (4/5 swing agents bullish, swing_breakout and swing_trend_momentum) invalidated by macro reversal (Iran escalation May 4, WTI +$105) that converted the April 30 risk-on tailwind into a risk-off headwind; sub-threshold entry volume (1.23x vs. 1.5x minimum) was an early warning sign.
